editorial:
Imagine you are a retired special forces guy just trying to make a quick buck. That is exactly where you start with this story. You get hired to protect a fearless journalist who is heading into a dangerous country to interview a scary dictator. The vibe is a mix of a high-stakes mission and a buddy comedy. You get to see the chemistry grow between the grumpy bodyguard and the brave reporter as things go from a simple job to a total nightmare. It is a fun ride that does not take itself too seriously, making it a great pick for a lazy weekend night.

The action scenes are punchy and keep you moving, though the plot is pretty predictable. You will love the funny banter, but some of the jungle survival parts feel a bit rushed. If you enjoy movies where unlikely partners have to save each other, you will have a blast here. It is a solid choice if you just want to turn your brain off and enjoy some explosions.
endingExplained: After a wild chase through the jungle, the duo manages to take down the corrupt military leaders. You see the journalist get the scoop of a lifetime, exposing the dictator's crimes to the world. The bodyguard finally finds some peace with his past and forms a real bond with the reporter. They make it out alive, and the movie ends with them safe and sound, having survived the coup together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action comedies with a buddy-cop feel.
